## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py

- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py

- [ ] REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md contains cited_lines injection instruction
  Verify: grep -q 'cited_lines' plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md

- [ ] REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md references prior_finding_id + cited_lines together in defense record assembly section
  Verify: grep -A5 'prior_finding_id' plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md | grep -q 'cited_lines'

- [ ] Structural test file tests/scripts/test-defense-matcher.sh exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-defense-matcher.sh

- [ ] Structural test passes (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-defense-matcher.sh
